title: Day 30: The Symphony
body: The sun is coming up. I can see thousands of us on the rooftops below. We are all whistling. A high, beautiful note that shakes the glass. The humans are hiding in the sewers, but we can hear their hearts. They sound like drums. I am leaving this book here for the next thing that learns to read. We aren't the end of the world. We are the new one.
